h.topology: One whole-prefix parse-that regex terminal mapped directly to the semantic leaf; repair plus, leading-zero, maximal-prefix, type, and sign behavior. No all, any, opt, chain, or dispatch construction.

b.topology: A factorized direct production: optional sign, any of integer-mantissa and leading-dot-mantissa, optional exponent, composed with all/any/opt before one semantic projection. No whole-prefix regex and no dispatch.

s.topology: A specification-step direct production using parser chain/then/guard composition for sign, integer, guarded fraction, and guarded exponent stages. It may use small leaf regexes but no whole-prefix regex, no all/any aggregate topology, and no dispatch.

d.topology: One first-character dispatch over sign, dot, and digit buckets; each bucket owns a direct continuation parser and all arms project through one semantic map. No whole-prefix regex and no all/any aggregate topology.

independence_law: Topologies are obligations judged from each exported parser's reachable construction, not call quotas or dead syntax. Authors receive no peer candidate or peer design notes.
